artworks.title: "Dief-achtighe Tijs" and "Nies Spoel-de-Nap"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This image is a print featuring two separate portraits, side by side, each encased in an oval frame. On the left, the portrait depicts a man's upper body in profile, facing left. He has a pronounced nose and chin, with thin eyebrows and deeply set eyes; his hair is mostly concealed by a cap, but visibly curly at the ends. He appears to be wearing a simple garment or cloak. On the right, the portrait shows a woman also from the upper body, turned slightly to the left, but looking to the viewer's right. Her face is wrinkled, with pronounced cheekbones and a broad grin. She is wearing a hooded garment that covers her head. Both portraits are set against a background designed with horizontal lines, which adds texture to the image. The artwork style indicates it could be from an earlier period, possibly a historical or classical style of printmaking.

artworks.title: "'t Suynighe Waertje" and "De Goelicke Waerdin"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: Two individual portrait illustrations of elderly individuals are depicted. The left portrait shows an older man with minimal hair, prominent cheekbones, and sagging skin, wearing a light-colored shirt with a darker outer garment. The right portrait shows an older woman with sharp facial features, wrinkles, a hood covering her head, and similar attire to the man. Both are surrounded by oval frames filled with horizontal lines and are rendered in varying shades, creating a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: "Buyltje On-versaed" and "Waerner Altijdt-meer"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image displays two portraits side by side in oval frames. The left portrait depicts a person in profile facing right, with an elongated face, prominent nose, and visible wrinkles, wearing a hood or cowl. The right portrait shows a person facing forward with a round face, wearing a flat cap and a coat with a fur collar. The person has a pronounced nose and a stern expression. The background features fine horizontal lines, and both portraits are enclosed in oval borders. The image is rendered in a monochrome, engraved style.

artworks.title: "Foockel Lach-een-reys" and "Lazarus Sonder-Zeer"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person, with a focus on their head and shoulders. The person is slightly turned to the left, looking upwards. The face is expressive with a prominent nose and open mouth showing teeth. The hair is short and textured with some areas of highlight. The individual is wearing a loose garment, possibly a robe. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame as part of the print design, set against a lined background. The illustration is on a plain, aged piece of paper with some discoloration and stains.

artworks.title: "Harme Snap-op" and "Keursje-sonder-naed"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two oval-framed portraits placed next to each other. The left portrait features a person with curly hair and a headpiece, while the right portrait shows a person with a hood or draped fabric covering their head. Both individuals have distinct facial features and are depicted in a black and white linework style against a lined background.

artworks.title: "Voorsichtighe Krijn" and "Broentje Spaer-pots"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image contains two head-and-shoulders portraits in oval frames. The left portrait shows a man in profile view facing right, with distinct facial features and curly hair under a hat. The right portrait displays a woman in three-quarter profile facing right, with defined facial features and a hood covering most of her head. Both figures are depicted in a linear, engraved style against a background of closely spaced horizontal lines. The image is monochromatic, in shades of black and white, with no other elements present.

artworks.title: "Bruyntje Springh-in'-t- Bed" and "Flip de Duyvel"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving showing two individuals within separate oval frames. The person on the left has a rounded face with prominent lips and wide eyes. They have short, curly hair and are wearing a patterned hat and a top with a visible collar. The individual on the right also has a rounded face with distinct facial features such as wide eyes, prominent lips, and a short beard. Their hair is short and curly, and they are wearing an outfit with a more pronounced collar. The engraving background is filled with horizontal lines, providing texture and depth to the image while emphasizing the oval frames around the subjects.

artworks.title: "t Moye Molletje" and "Melis Bocke-baert"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image features two individuals depicted in oval frames, showing their upper bodies including their heads, shoulders, and part of their chests. The left individual is positioned facing slightly to the right with short, curly hair. Their facial features are well-defined with prominent eyes and lips. The person wears a garment with a visible collar. The right individual faces slightly to the left, with an open mouth. They have short, curly hair and a beard. Their garment appears similar in style to the first person, with a collar visible. Both frames are set against a lined background. The background outside the frames is plain.

artworks.title: "Schonckje Wel-bedrocht" and "Pronckje Heel-volmaeckt"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two profiles framed by separate oval borders. On the left, an elderly man is shown facing right, from the shoulders up with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and visible wrinkles. His hair is curly, and he wears a cap and a robe. On the right, an elderly woman is shown facing left, from the shoulders up with a pointed nose, prominent eyes, and a calm expression. She wears a head covering. The background consists of horizontal lines adding texture to each oval. The two portraits are adjacent, creating a symmetrical composition.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt, or The Miracle of the Palm Tree
artworks.medium: red chalk, squared for transfer and incised  around edges, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a drawing of three full figures in seated positions. The central figure is a woman holding a small child on her lap, while an older man sits slightly behind her. The woman's facial features are gently drawn with downturned eyes and subtle expressions, and her hair is tucked under a veil or cap. She wears a flowing garment. The man has a bald head, a beard, and a kind expression, dressed in a long robe. The baby reaches upwards. Two small cherubs or putti are floating around them. The background features sketched clouds and a landscape hint for depth perception. No visible objects or jewelry are included in the illustration.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.medium: etching (3 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: There is a drawing of historical scenes from the American Revolution. The full description is composed of three distinct panels. The first panel shows a group of people setting fire to papers in a street setting. The second panel depicts a bustling harbor with ships docked and people gesturing animatedly toward the water. The third panel shows a group of individuals aiming rifles with smoke billowing in the background. The drawing is done in intricate line work.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The image depicts a densely packed battlefield with numerous soldiers wielding long weapons. Wisps of smoke fill the air, reflecting musket or cannon fire. The soldiers are arranged in close ranks with attire and headgear reflecting a historical military style. At the bottom of the image is a text panel in German stating the event depicted and the date of June 17, 1774. The scene conveys the intensity of the battlefield under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.medium: etching (2 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: Two scenes from late 18th-century America are depicted in this drawing. The left panel shows an interior gathering with a long table covered by a cloth, surrounded by seated individuals in formal attire. The room is elegantly decorated, including a decorative ceiling with figures. The right panel shows an outdoor scene with soldiers in uniform and flags, engaging in military activities. A group of spectators is seated nearby under a large frame resembling a porch. The drawing features detailed architecture and historical events.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.medium: etching (2 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two historical scenes. The left panel shows a military setting, possibly a surrender, while the right panel depicts a formal meeting or an audience in a grand interior setting. In the left panel, figures in military attire overlook a group surrounded by raised bayonets. The landscape includes a mountain or hillside, suggesting an outdoor military engagement. The right panel illustrates an interior scene with elaborately dressed figures; one seated prominently while others stand or bow ceremonially. The room is adorned with heavy drapes and wall decorations, indicating an audience possibly involving a diplomat or envoy meeting with figures of authority. The drawing is detailed with outlines and shading, conveying a historical narrative.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military landing scene. It shows a group of soldiers disembarking from boats in a disciplined formation. In the foreground, a mounted soldier on a horse gestures towards the direction the soldiers are heading. The background is filled with the masts and flags of numerous ships. The drawing is detailed in its depiction of military uniforms and the organized movement of the troops. The handwritten text at the bottom states that it depicts a landing of the French army in America at Rhode Island on July 11, 1780.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.medium: etching (3 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three historical scenes. The first scene depicts a group of individuals involved in a confrontation in a wooded area. The middle scene shows soldiers with rifles and bayonets under a mountainous backdrop. The final scene showcases a formal gathering in an urban setting with people standing in lines, some holding banners or flags. Each panel contains text providing context to the narrative.

artworks.title: Jacob and Rebecca before Isaac [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. N. Richard Miller
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene with multiple figures and a dog. The drawing features a central scene with three prominent figures. The figures are arranged around a depth with a sense of emotion reflected in their gestures. The setting includes draped fabrics and a decorative urn on a table. Additionally, there is a dog in the lower left corner. The composition uses soft lines and shading to create a gentle atmosphere and depth.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins, Pastoral Figures, and Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite and brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white chalk, on apricot-prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Syma Busiel Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This horizontal landscape showing ruins in a countryside is drawn on dark parchment-brown paper. The view is framed to the left by a tall leafy tree that reaches off the top edge of the paper and to the right by ruins made up of two columns beneath an entablature. A group of four people sit together in the middle distance at the lower center of the composition while eight animals, possibly goats, graze and rest nearby. The animals, people, ruins, and tree to the left are drawn with brown ink. More trees and buildings in the distance at the center is drawn lightly with graphite, giving it a hazy look.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from within the ruins of an architectural structure. The scene showcases a series of towering, arched columns creating a pattern that draws the eye towards the background. The architecture and foliage dominate the view, with the sky and clouds visible through the arches and tree branches. The etching technique used in the artwork features detailed and precise lines defining the textures of the stone columns and foliage. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, with varying shades of black and white creating a dramatic composition. A large, ornate decorative element is near the base of a column. In the distance, the ruins extend with trees in the background. The image conveys a sense of aged grandeur and nature reclaiming the man-made.

artworks.title: Fountains
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 30 x 27 cm (11 13/16 x 10 5/8 in.)
sheet: 41 x 32.7 cm (16 1/8 x 12 7/8 in.)
overall (mat size): 55.9 x 40.6 cm (22 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a stone archway in an underground corridor or crypt. The perspective is slightly above and to the side, revealing a view down a line of columns and arches that extend into the distance. There is no visible horizon as the scene is indoors. A person is seated on the left, near us, possibly resting against a textured stone wall. Another figure is standing further down the path, draped in a cloak. The arches are detailed with brushstrokes to convey age and texture. The scene is monochrome, using shades of brown for depth and shadow. Light and shadow highlight the architectural details and set a mysterious tone.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 25.2 x 31.4 cm (9 15/16 x 12 3/8 in.)
Overall: 31.3 x 42.3 cm (12 5/16 x 16 5/8 in.)
overall (mat size): 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with towering stone arches and dense foliage. Large stone walls with intricate details are partially covered in plants and ivy. Taller arches are visible in the center with detailed brushwork capturing textures. The image is black and white, highlighting contrasts between stone, greenery, and light.

artworks.title: Saxon Arch
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: This image features a stone archway with intricate details framing the view beyond. The architectural structure is detailed with etchings, showing weathering and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and grey. In the foreground are architectural debris, including a stone with an inscription and a draped cloth. Beyond the archway are more arches and crumbling walls, partially hidden by trees and underbrush. The background shows the sky with tree branches.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The etching depicts a ruined abbey viewed from a slightly lower left angle. Architectural arches stretch upwards towards the horizon line with detailed lines emphasizing stone texture and vines on the walls. The color palette is monochromatic with varying greys and blacks. Debris and an animal lie near a large tree root. Additional arches and structural remnants are seen in the distance, with clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene featuring stone arches and columns of a ruined abbey. The viewpoint is slightly below, emphasizing the grandeur of the structure. The artwork is an etching with detailed line work. The monochromatic palette includes various shades of brown and black, creating contrast between light and shadow. Vines cover robust columns in the foreground, framing a series of arches that lead into the distance. The background shows the abbey's walls and openings revealing the sky and foliage beyond, evoking a sense of historical solitude.
